## Common Drow (CR 1/3)

**Variants**  
Drow Demonic Champion  
Drow House Captain  
Drow House Guard  
Drow Master Scout  
Drow Matron  
Drow Noble  
Drow Poisoner  
Drow Priest  
Drow Scout  



**XP** 135  
 Drow warrior 1  
 CE Medium humanoid (elf)  
 **Init** +2; **Senses** darkvision 120 ft.; Perception +2  
 


**Defense**

 
 **AC** 15, touch 12, flat-footed 13 (+2 armor, +2 Dex, +1 shield)  
 **hp** 10 (1d10)  
 **Fort** +2, **Ref** +2, Will—1; +2 vs. enchantment  
 **Immune** sleep; **SR** 7  
 **Weaknesses** light blindness  
 

**Offense**

 
 **Speed** 30 ft.  
 **Melee** rapier +3 (1d6+2/18–20)  
 **Ranged** hand crossbow +3 (1d4/19–20 plus poison)  
 **Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 1st)  
 
  1/day—dancing lights, darkness, faerie fire  
 

**Statistics**

 
 **Str** 11, **Dex** 15, **Con** 10, **Int** 10, **Wis** 9, **Cha** 10  
 **Base Atk** +1; **CMB** +3; **CMD** 13  
 **Feats** Weapon Finesse  
*House rules: Weapon Finesse adds Dex instead of Str to finesse damage and CMB.*  
 **Skills** Perception +2, Stealth +2; **Racial Modifiers** +2 Perception
